zh: 金管局與證監會合辦專題研討會
推動Project Ensemble代幣化存款
約200名金融從業員出席研討會
work.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Securities and Futures Commission co-hosted a seminar on Project Ensemble and tokenised SFC-authorised investment products on 11 November. Around 200 industry practitioners attended the event following the move to 24/7 tokenised deposits.
work.title: Project Ensemble Seeks Scale After Tokenised Deposits Go 24/7

zh: 港交所12月14日推數碼支付方案
採用24/7批發層面央行數碼貨幣
便利期貨結算參與者提交預繳按金
work.en: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX) will launch a new digital payment solution on 14 December using wholesale CBDC operating 24/7. Eligible futures clearing participants will be able to submit margin requests between 5:00 PM and 1:30 AM for T+1 trading sessions.
work.title: 港交所下月推出新數碼支付方案 支付收市後交易時段預繳按金

zh: 金管局經貼現窗投放76.6億元
規模創下近7年以來的新高
向本港銀行體系注入短線流動性
work.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority injected HK$76.6 billion of liquidity into the banking system through its discount window. This represents the largest single-day injection via the facility in nearly seven years.
work.title: 金管局經貼現窗向銀行放水76.6億 近7年最多

zh: 外匯基金10月境外資產增加
按月增加570億港元
總額升至36330億元
work.en: Foreign assets of the Exchange Fund increased by HK$57 billion in October to reach HK$3.633 trillion. Total claims on the private sector in Hong Kong stood at HK$427.8 billion, while foreign liabilities totaled HK$140.3 billion.
work.title: 外匯基金上月境外資產增加570億港元

zh: 工商銀行發行二級資本債券
順利募集600億元人民幣
債券票息最低為1.77%
work.en: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (01398) raised RMB 60 billion through the issuance of Tier 2 capital bonds. The lowest coupon rate achieved on the bonds was 1.77%.
work.title: 工商銀行(01398)發行二級資本債券籌獲600億人幣，票息最低1.77%

zh: 本港銀行持續爭奪存款
港元1年期定存最高3.6厘
數碼銀行兩年期提供3.5厘
work.en: Hong Kong banks continue aggressive promotions for Hong Kong dollar deposits, with one-year deposit rates reaching up to 3.6%. Virtual banks are offering rates up to 3.5% for two-year terms, while short-term promotions reach up to 20%.
work.title: 定期存款

zh: 月之暗面擬在香港申請IPO
目標明年初完成上市程序
計劃集資額高達50億美元
work.en: AI startup Moonshot AI aims to list in Hong Kong early next year. The company is targeting an IPO fundraising size of up to US$5 billion.
work.title: WSJ：「AI六小虎」月之暗面目標明年初在港上市擬IPO募資達50億美元(16:55) - 20261113 - 即時財經新聞

zh: 星宸科技傳考慮在港上市
該公司為內地晶片製造商
預計上市集資額約23億元
work.en: Chipmaker SigmaStar Technology is reportedly planning a Hong Kong listing. The IPO is expected to raise HK$2.3 billion.
work.title: IPO丨晶片商星宸科技傳港上市籌23億

smalltalk_hk.headline: Hong Kong Third Quarter GDP Expands by 5.2%
smalltalk_hk.body: Hong Kong's economy grew by 5.2% in the third quarter of 2026, supported by external trade growth and solid domestic demand. Real GDP expanded strongly according to revised government estimates.
smalltalk_hk.title: Economy rises 5.2% in Q3

smalltalk_hk.headline: Cisco Reports Q1 Revenue Growth Driven by AI Demand
smalltalk_hk.body: Cisco posted a 24% revenue increase in Q1 and raised its AI infrastructure revenue target to $9 billion. Its stock rose over 3% in after-hours trading.

smalltalk_hk.headline: JD.com Completes Acquisition of Ceconomy Stake
smalltalk_hk.body: JD.com has completed its acquisition of a 59.8% controlling stake in German consumer electronics retailer Ceconomy.

smalltalk_hk.headline: Applied Materials Posts 53% Revenue Surge
smalltalk_hk.body: Applied Materials reported a 53% surge in Q4 revenue to hit a record high, while adjusted earnings per share rose 92%. Shares rose nearly 2% in after-market trading.

smalltalk_hk.headline: Cerebras Cloud AI Revenue Up 272%
smalltalk_hk.body: Cerebras reported a 272% increase in Q3 cloud AI revenue and projected next year's sales to triple. The stock surged over 16% to 20% in extended trading following the release.

smalltalk_sg.headline: MAS, Bank of England and Bank of Thailand Complete Cross-Border Settlement Trial
smalltalk_sg.body: The Monetary Authority of Singapore, Bank of England, and Bank of Thailand completed Project Meridian, testing cross-border foreign exchange settlement mechanisms.
smalltalk_sg.title: MAS, Bank of England and Bank of Thailand complete FX settlement trial

smalltalk_sg.headline: Former Lee Kuan Yew Family Properties Put Up for Sale
smalltalk_sg.body: Two Good Class Bungalow properties in Singapore where Lee Kuan Yew's sister-in-law previously lived have been placed on the market for S$26 million and S$27 million.
smalltalk_sg.title: Properties where Lee Kuan Yew's sister-in-law once lived now on sale for S$26 million & S$27 million

smalltalk_sg.headline: Tourists Film Themselves Littering into Singapore River
smalltalk_sg.body: A Reddit video of young tourists throwing trash into the Singapore River at Clarke Quay sparked online outrage, with residents calling for fines and clean-up orders.
smalltalk_sg.title: Netizen in Singapore shocked at 'terrible' tourists who threw trash into river, says they 'should be embarrassed, fined, & made to pick up’

personal_hk.headline: 香港迪士尼樂園發現網絡事件 警方暫列不誠實意圖而取用電腦
personal_hk.body:
迪士尼樂園網上系統疑被盜1.7萬個門票二維碼，已暫停網上售票並報警處理。
園方已加強現場核實門票程序，案件由大嶼山警區重案組跟進。
personal_hk.title: 香港迪士尼官網暫停售票 據了解票務系統疑被盜1.7萬個二維碼

personal_hk.headline: 受美國停飛令影響 往來香港與美國部分航班取消或延誤
personal_hk.body:
美國停飛令解除後，全日共有5班來往香港與美國的航班取消、11班延誤。
機管局預計今明兩日相關航班仍會受一定程度影響。
personal_hk.title: 機管局指受美國停飛令影響 部分往來香港與美國航班要取消或延誤

personal_hk.headline: 82歲女子懷疑被輕型貨車撞倒 司機涉危險駕駛被捕
personal_hk.body:
牛頭角道交界一輛輕型貨車撞倒過路八旬老婦，傷者昏迷送院。
40歲男司機涉嫌危險駕駛被捕扣查。
personal_hk.title: 82歲女子懷疑被輕型貨車撞倒 司機涉危險駕駛被捕

personal_hk.headline: 37歲菲傭涉嫌虐兒被捕 懷疑曾掌摑一名7歲男童面部
personal_hk.body:
觀塘協和街單位一名7歲男童疑遭菲傭掌摑面部受驚鼻痛送院。
涉案37歲外傭涉虐兒被警方拘捕扣查。
personal_hk.title: 37歲菲傭涉嫌虐兒被捕 懷疑曾掌摑一名7歲男童面部

personal_hk.body: 旅發局舉辦美食月，由星級名廚及侍酒師打造16款期間限定餐酒配搭餐單。

juicy_hk.headline: 香港迪士尼系統遭非法入侵 1.7萬張門票二維碼遭擷取盜用
juicy_hk.body: 香港迪士尼樂園官方網絡系統遭黑客入侵，有達1.7萬個門票二維碼疑被非法擷取盜用。園方已緊急暫停網上售票並報警處理，重案組正在調查系統驗證漏洞。

juicy_hk.headline: 微軟全球爆發大規模死機 Copilot與Teams服務一度癱瘓
juicy_hk.body: 微軟系統發出全球性故障，旗下Outlook、Teams及Copilot等工具集體癱瘓。港區打工仔於上班時段無法正常收發公事電郵，辦公效率大受影響。

juicy_sg.headline: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Facing 3rd Affair Allegations as Separation Could Trigger S$90B Payout
juicy_sg.body: Allegations of a third affair involving a second Nvidia employee have fueled speculation over Jensen Huang's marriage. A potential divorce settlement could entitle his wife Lori to around US$70 billion (S$90 billion).
juicy_sg.title: Jensen Huang’s 3rd affair allegations with 2nd Nvidia employee fuel divorce speculation; wife could get S$90B upon separation

juicy_sg.headline: Singapore Bars Megaspeed Director Alice Huang and Files 41 Charges in Nvidia Chip Smuggling Probe
juicy_sg.body: Singapore barred tech director Alice Huang from re-entry after she misled police during an investigation into Megaspeed's AI server deals. A male suspect faces 41 charges in connection with illegal Nvidia chip transfers.
juicy_sg.title: Singapore Barred Alice Huang From Entry Over Megaspeed Probe

juicy_sg.headline: 2 Thai Workers Brawled at Changi Airport Food Court, 1 Sentenced to 11 Weeks Jail
juicy_sg.body: A physical fight broke out between two Thai women at a Changi Airport food court. One of the workers involved was sentenced to 11 weeks in prison.
juicy_sg.title: 2 women, Thai workers, fight at Changi Airport food court, 1 jailed for 11 weeks

juicy_sg.headline: Fire at 80-Year-Old Chinatown TCM Shop Forces 40 Evacuations
juicy_sg.body: A fire broke out at an 80-year-old traditional Chinese medicine and liquor shop in Chinatown on November 11. Two people were hospitalized and approximately 40 residents were evacuated.
juicy_sg.title: Fire at 80-year-old Chinatown TCM and liquor shop sends 2 to hospital, forces 40 to evacuate

juicy_sg.headline: 8 Teenagers Arrested over Late-Night Door-Knocking Pranks in Hougang
juicy_sg.body: Eight teenagers between the ages of 12 and 15 were arrested for repeatedly knocking on doors late at night in Hougang and uploading videos of the pranks to social media.
juicy_sg.title: 8 teenagers suspected of knocking on Hougang residents’ doors at night and posting videos online
